behaviourFreeHelpers.why: Registered in this admission commit per the B14-0A reviewer recommendation and Root's instruction, so RED stays test-only. No product file references any of them at this commit (git grep in src outside __tests__ finds only the helper itself); the 14 seams already override matchLacksRevealProjection, so the factory shape is unchanged. Existing exports (FOG_REFUSAL, noPerViewerRevealProjection) are byte-identical.

design.admission: ServerMatchHost.admitSocket: current membership is resolved first (non-members keep the pre-existing generic AUTH_REJECTED / 1008, infrastructure 1011); then matchLacksRevealProjection is awaited; any refusal sends the fixed frame, physically closes and detaches before attachSocket, so the socket is never a broadcast recipient.
design.live: ServerMatchHostEvents.publishEvent: per recipient, after viewer resolution and before any frame shaping or delivery-number assignment, noPerViewerRevealProjection(meta?.config) refuses: meta === null (unreadable) -> unavailable (Error + 1011), otherwise policy (Close + 1008); the socket is detached so later publishes send nothing. fogMeta is computed with optional chaining so a readable meta with an undefined config cannot throw.
design.replay: ServerMatchHostReplay.sendReplay: membership/viewer resolution first, then matchLacksRevealProjection before any event read (getReplayEventsForPlayer / getEventsFromSeq) or ReplayStart; refusal returns false and the host detaches (join and direct replay). Legacy reconnect callback: a metadata peer triggers the config read; a policy refusal answers fog-projection-unavailable only after the durable seat confirms current membership, else the generic "Match in progress"; an unreadable config answers the generic reason; fog-off goes to answerReconnectRequest unchanged.
design.closeCodes: Membership/policy refusal 1008; infrastructure (membership lookup failure, unreadable fog config) 1011; join membership refusal and join guard failure now also physically close (1008/1011) per closePolicy. Pre-upgrade invalid credentials remain HTTP 401 in server.js (unchanged).
design.seatOrder: MatchWireSealedChoices and both S seat arguments untouched; the refusal precedes the sealed-choice audience context entirely.
design.knownOff: Known-off and flag-omitted configs return false from both decisions; the fog-off two-players-plus-GM path is unchanged (pinned unmocked).
